name: get_protein_structure_info
description: Fetch detailed information about a protein structure from the Protein Data Bank (PDB) using a PDB ID. Returns metadata including the protein name, organism, resolution, and structural details. Use this tool when you have a specific PDB ID (e.g. '1A0S'). Do NOT use this tool for general protein information; for that, use 'get_uniprot_protein_info'.

parameters.name: pdb_id
parameters.description: The 4-character PDB identifier for the protein structure (e.g. '1A0S'). Must be a valid PDB ID; the function raises an error if not found.

parameters.name: include_details
parameters.description: Whether to include detailed structural information such as atom coordinates and connectivity. Set to false for a summary response. Defaults to true.

protein_name.description: Recommended protein name from the PDB.

organism.description: Scientific name of the source organism (e.g. 'Homo sapiens').

resolution.description: Resolution of the structure in angstroms (e.g. 2.0).

structural_details.description: Detailed structural information including atom coordinates and connectivity. Only present if include_details=true.

return_schema.description: Metadata about the protein structure, including optional detailed structural information.
